children.name: Martynia annua L.
children.description: " Habitat in Americes Vera Cruce. " RCN: 4473.

children.name: Martynia palmeri S.Watson
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (Baja California). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Craniolaria annua L.
children.description: The native range of this species is Hispaniola, Colombia to N. South America. It is a annual and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Craniolaria integrifolia Cham.
children.description: The native range of this species is Bolivia to Brazil and N. Argentina. It is a annual or perennial and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Ibicella lutea  Van Eselt.
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil to N. Argentina. It is a annual and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Ibicella parodii Abbiatti
children.description: The native range of this species is E. & S. Bolivia to N. Argentina. It is a annual and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Holoregmia viscida Nees
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Bahia). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Proboscidea althaeifolia  Decne.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Mexico to W. Texas and N. Mexico, Peru. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Proboscidea diversifolia Hevly
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (Jalisco, Michoacán). It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Proboscidea parviflora  Wooton & Standl.
children.description: Proboscidea parviflora is a species of flowering plant in the family Martyniaceae known by the common names doubleclaw and red devil's-claw.

children.name: Proboscidea sabulosa Correll
children.description: Proboscidea sabulosa is a species of flowering plant in the family Martyniaceae known by the common names sanddune unicorn-plant, dune unicorn plant and dune devil's claw.

children.name: Proboscidea spicata Correll
children.description: Proboscidea spicata, the New Mexico unicorn-plant, is a herbaceous, flowering plant.

children.name: Proboscidea triloba  Decne.
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico to Guatemala. It is a annual and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
